targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    event_time,
    if(query_kind = 'Insert', 'INSERT', 'SELECT') AS query_type,
    query_duration_ms,
    read_rows,
    splitByChar('\n', exception)[1] AS error,
    substring(query, 1, 120) AS query_preview
FROM system.query_log
WHERE type = 'ExceptionWhileProcessing'
    AND event_time >= now() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 20

panels.title: CH — Recent Failed Queries
